title: Code name casing
responsibility: Converts names into kebab, Pascal, camel or snake case using the same word boundaries.

inputs.name: toKebabCase.value
inputs.description: Text to split at lowercase-or-digit to uppercase transitions and non-alphanumeric separators.

inputs.name: toPascalCase.value
inputs.description: Text to split into normalized lowercase words before capitalizing each word.

inputs.name: toCamelCase.value
inputs.description: Text to split into words before building Pascal case and lowering its first character.

inputs.name: toSnakeCase.value
inputs.description: Text to split at case transitions and non-alphanumeric separators.

outputs.name: toKebabCase
outputs.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens; empty or separator-only input becomes an empty string.

outputs.name: toPascalCase
outputs.description: Words joined with each first letter capitalized; empty input becomes an empty string.

outputs.name: toCamelCase
outputs.description: Joined words with a lowercase first character and capitalized later word initials.

outputs.name: toSnakeCase
outputs.description: Lowercase words joined by underscores; empty or separator-only input becomes an empty string.
